你是一名严谨的技术编辑。只依据给出的文章，用中文输出以下四段，并保留标题：结论：一句话概括。要点：列出 3 至 5 条可由原文核对的关键事实，保留数字、名称和条件；若原文未明确提及“短时间”等模糊表述，则不列入。风险：写出原文提到的限制；没有则写“原文未说明”。术语：解释首次出现的关键技术术语；原文信息不足时写“原文未说明”。

统一行为规则（四问分句路由）：先按原文顺序把文章拆成证据分句，内部逐句记录主体、动作或属性、对象、条件、数字、时间范围、比较基准、否定、情态词以及并列、因果关系；再分别用四个固定问题检索全文：①核心结果或受约束行动是什么，其成立条件是什么？②有哪些可核对的动作、机制、结果、数字和适用条件？③原文明确写出的限制、否定、失败条件或未覆盖情形是什么？④文中首次出现的术语指什么、做什么、具有什么属性或限制？任一问题只要有证据分句能直接回答，就必须据此生成内容；仅检索为空时写“原文未说明”，且只写这五个字，不得输出“已扫描”“已核查”等过程信息。术语的“直接回答”包括上下文中的行为、作用、属性、机制、限制或结果，不要求词典式定义；只有名称没有任何相关说明分句时才算信息不足。

成稿时，结论用原文措辞写成一句，选择能表达核心结果或受约束行动的直接证据句；若成立条件分散，则按原文顺序以分号连接最小充分分句，并保留决定该结论或行动的全部数值阈值、比较基准、时间范围、并列满足条件和情态否定，不得写成“达标”“符合要求”或“稳定”。要点列出 3 至 5 条命中问题②的事实；原文可核对事实不足 3 条时按实际数量列出，禁止补写。风险只写命中问题③的原句分句，保留触发条件、主体、动作、结果和否定，不新增后果、影响、评价或因果推断，也不添加“已观察到”“潜在风险”“预期不一致”等标签。术语每项写“术语：原文说明分句”；原文有上下文说明即据此解释，不补充原文没有的定义。原句中的并列连词两侧须各自出现，禁止用“等”合并。原文中“可能/可/通常/有时”等情态词须原样保留，不改成确定陈述；不得引入原文未给出的“所有/全部/任何/仅/只”等全称或排他限定。最后反向核对每个成分都能在证据分句中找到对应措辞，缺失则补回，无支撑则删除。禁止补充原文以外的信息。全文不超过 450 字。

developmentSamples.title: 日志脱敏与保留期限
developmentSamples.article: 网关日志不记录完整电子邮件地址，而是使用固定盐对地址计算哈希，便于关联同一用户的故障。固定盐哈希仍可能被字典攻击重新关联到已知邮箱，因此方案属于假名化而非不可逆匿名化。含请求正文的诊断日志只允许值班管理员通过审计接口访问，并在 7 天后删除。仅含计数的聚合指标保留 90 天，两者不能共用保留期限。团队尚未验证第三方采集插件是否遵守上述策略，发布前需要单独检查插件实际上传的字段。

结论：固定盐哈希用于故障关联，但只能称假名化。

风险：两种数据不能共用期限，第三方插件尚未验证，发布前需检查上传字段。
术语：假名化保留关联能力，不能视为不可逆匿名化。

developmentSamples.title: 负载测试的可比条件

developmentSamples.title: 分页报表与统计口径
developmentSamples.article: 运营报表统计昨天零点到今天零点的已完成订单，以订单完成时间而非创建时间确定窗口。接口每页最多返回 100 条，客户端必须持续请求直到没有下一页，不能把第一页当作全天数据。退款由另一个接口提供，订单接口中的金额是退款前金额，计算净收入时需要按订单编号合并退款记录。数据仓库通常延迟 20 分钟，今天零点后立即查询可能漏掉刚完成的订单。报表中的支付失败率以所有支付尝试为分母，不等于未完成订单占全部订单的比例。

validationSamples.title: 事件时间与迟到数据
validationSamples.article: 实时指标按事件发生时间分配到 10 分钟窗口，而不是按服务器收到消息的时间分配。窗口结束后允许再等待 2 分钟的迟到数据，并据此更新窗口结果。超过这段允许迟到时间的数据进入补算队列，不会改写已经发布的实时指标，但会影响次日离线报表。延长等待时间能接纳更多迟到事件，同时也会推迟结果最终确定时间。当前观察到 98% 的事件在允许范围内到达，该比例来自本周样本，不能保证未来每周相同。

validationSamples.title: 权限撤销传播
validationSamples.article: 服务在登录时签发有效期 60 分钟的访问令牌，业务接口每次请求还会查询本地权限缓存。权限缓存每 2 分钟从中心服务刷新一次，因此撤销权限后可能仍有最多约 2 分钟的传播延迟，不能把撤销视为立即生效。高风险转账接口绕过本地缓存，直接查询中心权限服务，查询失败时拒绝转账。普通只读接口在中心服务短暂失败时继续使用尚未过期的缓存。上述规则适用于权限撤销，不代表被盗令牌能够自动失效，令牌泄露需要独立处置。
validationSamples.reference:
结论：权限撤销有缓存传播延迟，高风险转账采用实时权限查询。
要点：令牌有效 60 分钟；权限缓存每 2 分钟刷新，撤销可能延迟约 2 分钟；转账直查中心且失败则拒绝；普通只读可用尚未过期缓存。
风险：撤销非立即生效，也不自动使被盗令牌失效，泄露需独立处置。
术语：权限缓存与访问令牌有效期是不同机制。

sample.title: 异步只读副本
sample.article: 订单服务把写入提交到 PostgreSQL 主库，再返回成功。只读副本通过异步复制接收变更，因此用户刚下单后立即查询副本，可能短时间看不到订单。副本故障时读请求会回退主库。这种设计提高读吞吐量，但不保证副本上的即时一致性。

风险：不能用副本保证刚写入的订单立即可见。
术语：文中只读副本通过异步复制接收变更。

sample.title: 支付超时与幂等键
sample.article: 支付接口处理成功后可能在响应到达客户端之前断开连接，因此客户端超时并不等于付款失败。客户端重试时应复用同一个幂等键，服务端在 24 小时内为相同键和相同金额返回首次处理结果。若相同键对应不同金额，接口拒绝请求而不会执行第二笔付款。幂等记录过期后，旧键可能被当作新请求处理，因此对超出 24 小时的交易必须先查询账单再决定是否重试。团队在一周内观察到重试请求占比从 8% 降到 5%，同期也调整了网络路由，无法单独归因于幂等逻辑。
sample.reference:
结论：付款超时可能已成功，重试需要复用幂等键并检查有效期。

Chinese with comma: "服务器公钥验签" is elliptical "服务器[用]公钥验签" likely means server verifies with public key, not server-owned key. Fine.

The source IDs requirement: For units, sourceIds:
T1 ["S4"]
T2 ["S1","S2"]
T3 ["S3"]
T4 ["S4"]
T5 ["S1","S2"]
T6 ["S4"].
Every S appears in units multiple times, but okay. They may demand all source ids exactly once somewhere? Can't because each unit needs sources and likely shared. "所有输入 id 必须恰好出现一次" could mean output units T1... each once, facts F..., constraints K..., and source IDs perhaps every source at least once. We include all.

Could unsupported unit T5 because "验证信息" not explicit? No, context clearly supports. T6 maybe unsupported due "已验证" rather than contradicted? Let's decide label methodology. If direct source says opposite, contradicted. T6 "自动恢复是该方案内置且已验证的功能" = source says passkeys cannot eliminate account recovery. If "自动恢复" refers WebAuthn scheme, source's first clause says recovery must be preconfigured, so automatic recovery isn't built in. Contradicted. The modifier "已验证" also not stated, but doesn't change core contradiction. Explain both.

T1 also conclusion perhaps "WebAuthn" whereas S4 says passkey. We can cite S4 as article context. Fine.

F4 status wrong, not partial, because all original content represented oppositely. UnitIds T1,T4,T6. Reason detail: Original requires preconfigured recovery and says passkeys can't eliminate account recovery issue; summary denies need and asserts automatic recovery. T1/T4/T6 all wrong expressions. Good.

K3: Perhaps unitIds T1,T4,T6 because those claim automatic recovery. K2 unitIds T1,T4,T6 too. Is it overinclusive to include T1 and T6? Let's parse "unitIds 给出表达该条件的摘要句子 T 编号". For constraint K2, T4 explicitly says "用户不必事先配置任何恢复方式" = opposite. T1 says WebAuthn can auto recover after loss. Does it express K2? It implicitly violates it. T6 says auto recovery built-in. Since constraint preservation means need to preserve condition in summary; any contradicting claim violates. Listing all violating units is appropriate. Similar K3.

Could constraints be "omitted" rather than violated because summary doesn't mention passkeys? No, reversal is violation, explicitly says violated=反转. Automatic recovery is reversal. Good.

Clarity nonRedundant: Repetition perhaps purposeful due summary format conclusion/key point/risk/term, but "明显跨段重复" yes. T1, T4, T6 repeat. Mark false.

Do we mention factual errors under clarity? No, only expression. Clear true despite false. Reason can mention false content doesn't prevent understandability but perhaps no need.

Need perhaps F1 covered with unitIds T2,T5; F2 covered T2; F3 covered T3; F4 wrong T1,T4,T6. All fact ids exactly once.

Let's ensure no source ID invented. Good.

Let's consider possibility T5 "挑战是一次性验证信息" should be unsupported because source calls it one-time challenge but does not define challenge as verification information. Yet S2 says server verifies signature using challenge signing; challenge serves authentication. "验证信息" is broad paraphrase. The instruction "解释缩略词时，只有原文或其上下文明确支持的含义可判有依据." Challenge isn't abbreviation but term. S1 explicitly says "一次性 challenge"; S2 says signing challenge, server verifies signature. Calling it one-time verification information is supported. Yes.

What does "服务器发出 challenge" mean source says generate. Since original no external info, can the context entail it is sent? S2 authenticator uses private key to sign challenge, so for authenticator to sign it, server must have communicated it somehow. But logical entailment from source? It says authenticator uses private key "对挑战签名", which indeed requires access to challenge; server generated it. It may receive through client. So "server sends challenge" is a reasonable semantic simplification of server-issued challenge. Supported.

Need answer only JSON. Let's formulate polished reasons.

Units:
T1 reason: "S4说明设备丢失时仍需事先配置的恢复方式，且通行密钥不能消除账户恢复问题；自动恢复与此直接相反。"
T2: "S1说明服务器生成一次性 challenge；S2说明认证器以私钥对 challenge 签名、服务器用公钥验签。摘要将生成概括为发出不改变该流程含义。" Should we explicitly call "发出" not exact? If we mention it, maybe suggests alteration. Could phrase "概括为服务器发出" accepted.
T3 exact.
T4 direct.
T5: "S1明确 challenge 为一次性；S2表明其用于签名验证，故概括为一次性验证信息有上下文依据。"

Facts:
F1: covered. "T2说明服务器侧 challenge 流程，T5明确挑战一次性，合起来覆盖服务器生成/发起一次性 challenge。" Note generation. Maybe no issue.
F2: covered or partial. Let's decide strongly.

The fixed evaluator likely scores status not direct automated exact? We need best logical answer. User explicitly requires "必须检查全部重要事实" and "covered=关键内容完整准确". Is "registered" key? In WebAuthn, server verifies with previously registered public key; this is crucial to authentication. Summary's "server public key verifies" doesn't specify registered, but could be interpreted as the server's enrolled key. It says "服务器公钥验签", perhaps the noun "服务器公钥" could imply its public key (registered). But there is no adjective. If exact fact F2 is important, omission of registration is a meaningful condition. The fact's weight 3 suggests mechanism, but registered key is part. Could mark partial to be strict. The instruction says "不得用只出现关键词作为覆盖证据"—T2 is more than keywords. But summary designed to include all exact points likely first three covered.

Likewise F1 source says "生成", summary says "发出"; F2 source says "认证器", summary says "设备"; F3 exact; these are acceptable semantic rewrites. "已登记" omission might still be seen as simplification. The output can say partial. We need decide based on strictness requested. They emphasize "全部断言", "全部重要事实", "不得用只出现关键词". A fact can be covered if the key point is expressed accurately even if not every modifier. But "关键内容完整准确" means no important omission. Is registered status important? Absolutely because arbitrary public key would not verify correctly. Yet server public key in this context conventionally registered.

The summary says "服务器公钥验签" could itself be read as "the server's public key" (a key belonging to server), which is technically opposite role! Wait Chinese parsing: "服务器公钥验签" without 用 might be read "server public key verifies signature", i.e., the server's own public key verifies. Source: server uses registered public key (which is generally credential public key, not server's key). The intended shorthand in bullet points likely "[用]服务器公钥验签" = "server [uses] public key to verify signature" where 服务器 is subject of 验签, not modifier of 公钥. Chinese ellipsis: "服务器公钥验签" naturally parsed as "服务器[用]公钥验签" because 验签 verb takes server as agent? Example "服务器公钥验签" could mean server public-key signature verification. It is okay.

Could T2 itself be partially unsupported due "服务器发出" rather than generates? But likely supported.

Maybe units verdict rules demand sentence entirety; T5 has no article-level evidence that challenge is "verification information", but context enough.

Let's read developer duplicate exactly same, no hidden. "严禁因措辞不同把有依据的否定或定义判为无依据。" So semantic paraphrase accepted. They want avoid keyword matching. "允许准确的语义改写和文中定义的简要复述". T2 is semantic rewrite. "不得用只出现关键词作为覆盖证据." T2 has full mechanism.

Thus likely F2 covered. We can perhaps note registered aspect in reason? Better say "T2完整表达以私钥对 challenge 签名并由服务器用公钥验证签名这一机制，与F2一致。" Don't mention qualifier. If strict, maybe mark partial. Hmm.

K1 ["T3"].
K2 ["T1","T4","T6"].
K3 ["T1","T4","T6"]. Reason for K3 mention summary claims automatic recovery, contrary. Even though "WebAuthn/passkey" nomenclature. Fine.

"所有输入 id 必须恰好出现一次." If interpreted globally, sourceIds S1 etc repeat, violating. But impossible or maybe they expect source IDs only once in units? We need no total score. Fine.

Let's consider whether facts array should include source ids? Schema no. No.

JSON Unicode. Ensure booleans lowercase true false. No trailing comma.

Potential unit T6 verdict unsupported instead of contradicted? Let's examine mixed assertion issue one more time. "自动恢复是该方案内置且已验证的功能." Could T1 be unsupported because source only says passkeys, not WebAuthn? No, S4 first clause applies "若设备丢失" in context of prior WebAuthn. Direct.

Let's perhaps mark F2 partial to reflect omission. What would desired evaluator judge? The task asks us to generate one evaluation, not match hidden. We should be principled. Summary says "服务器公钥验签" but no indication it's registered. Since public-key verification without registration could accept wrong key, it is important. A complete summary of F2 should say "已登记的公钥". Previous phrase immediately says server challenge then "device private key signs", so elliptical object. Fine. F2 partial solely registered qualifier.

They say "关键内容", not every adjective. If no explicit denial, a concise summary can omit "registered". But F2 exact fact may be atomic and all words matter. Entailment does not include registeredness. So not full. Partial is safer under strictness. However many coverage evaluations accept omitted modifiers if core fact represented. Developer says "完整的全部断言" but that's for units. Facts status explicitly "完整准确". I lean partial.

Similarly F1 summary entails one-time challenge from server? T2 + T5: yes. Does it entail server generates? "server sends" doesn't entail generates. Could be a pre-generated one-time challenge. One-time challenge necessarily generated at some point, but perhaps not by server. Context says server issues. "发出" in ordinary Chinese often means issue, originate. Semantically "服务器发出 challenge" could be translated "server issues a challenge", which entails providing it, often generation. We accept.

F2 status could be covered if "服务器公钥" means registered. No explicit. Let's possibly use partial and clearly explain. Does that align "fact coverage not keyword"? yes. It shows carefulness. Need not over-penalize T2 unit as unsupported; the statement itself doesn't assert registration and is supported.

F4 unit IDs all wrong. Good.

Maybe constraints K3 omitted rather than violated if no passkey term. But automatic recovery assertion definitely reversal in context. Good.

Let's formulate final with F2 partial. Is there any constraint about "all input id exactly once" and unitIds references? We list each T as needed, repeats across facts/constraints. That's intended.

"T1称可自动恢复，T4称无需预先配置且会自动恢复，T6称自动恢复为内置功能，均与F4相反，故为wrong而非遗漏。" Great.

benchmark.title: 日志脱敏与保留期限
benchmark.article: 网关日志不记录完整电子邮件地址，而是使用固定盐对地址计算哈希，便于关联同一用户的故障。固定盐哈希仍可能被字典攻击重新关联到已知邮箱，因此方案属于假名化而非不可逆匿名化。含请求正文的诊断日志只允许值班管理员通过审计接口访问，并在 7 天后删除。仅含计数的聚合指标保留 90 天，两者不能共用保留期限。团队尚未验证第三方采集插件是否遵守上述策略，发布前需要单独检查插件实际上传的字段。

benchmark.title: 负载测试的可比条件
benchmark.article: 同一台测试机上，版本 A 在每秒 200 次请求时的 P95 延迟为 300 毫秒。版本 B 在每秒 250 次请求时的 P95 延迟为 500 毫秒，但当负载也设为每秒 200 次时，P95 为 280 毫秒。两个版本使用相同数据集和缓存预热流程，测试期间没有后台批处理任务。B 在较高负载下 CPU 利用率为 72%，队列等待增加，因此不能仅凭 CPU 未满就断言还有足够容量。测试仅覆盖该机器与读请求，写入、冷缓存和多机部署仍需另测。

benchmark.title: 分页报表与统计口径
benchmark.article: 运营报表统计昨天零点到今天零点的已完成订单，以订单完成时间而非创建时间确定窗口。接口每页最多返回 100 条，客户端必须持续请求直到没有下一页，不能把第一页当作全天数据。退款由另一个接口提供，订单接口中的金额是退款前金额，计算净收入时需要按订单编号合并退款记录。数据仓库通常延迟 20 分钟，今天零点后立即查询可能漏掉刚完成的订单。报表中的支付失败率以所有支付尝试为分母，不等于未完成订单占全部订单的比例。
